Traditional Indian bull-taming ritual resumes
videos.description:
(5 Feb 2017) A traditional but controversial bull-taming sport called Jallikattu resumed in southern India on Sunday, attracting thousands of spectators and participants.
Jallikattu involves releasing a bull into a crowd of bull-tamers who attempt to grab it and ride the animal.
It's hugely popular in southern Tamil Nadu state, but India's top court banned it in 2014 on grounds of animal cruelty.
